purpose: preview-only: user chooses before game transfer

prompts.A: Use case: stylized-concept. Preview-only sprite concept board for a cozy medieval farming RPG. Match the supplied existing interior atlas: warm shaded oak and stone, orthographic three-quarter top-down game view, clear dark contour, detailed hand-painted pixel-friendly material shading that reads at 150x120 game pixels. Transparent background. EXACTLY NINE distinct isolated compact crafting stations in a clean THREE ROWS by THREE COLUMNS grid, generous equal gutters, NO scene, floors, people, labels, text, numerals, border or watermark. Each row shows the same station type upgraded from level one at left to two in the center and three at right; same apparent game scale and consistent ground pivot within each row. Top row: sawmill, level1 wooden sawhorse with hand saw and log, level2 sturdy saw bench with toothed wheel and crank, level3 compact metal-braced precision saw bench with protected circular blade and organized planks. Middle row: pottery, level1 wooden kick pottery wheel with clay bowl and water bucket, level2 reinforced foot-driven wheel with drawers and sample vases, level3 refined precision pottery wheel with tool rack and glazed samples. Bottom row: glassblowing, level1 small brick reheating furnace plus wooden bench, blowpipe and one bottle, level2 larger enclosed brick furnace with bellows and orderly glassware bench, level3 efficient stone furnace with brass measuring tools, lens and clear lunar-blue glass samples. Keep machinery compact, practical and readable; no industrial factory scale, no giant gears, no unsafe sprawling blades. Direction A: rustic artisan workshops, amber oak, dark iron, terracotta clay and clear blue-tinted glass. Progression comes from sturdier construction and better tooling; subtle moon motifs only on top tier.
